translation_implies_source.reasoning: For the translated witness, consider q_t + a(x)q_x = 0 in the original scalar dependent variable. Its coefficient is smooth and its one-by-one matrix is hyperbolic. The coefficient cannot be constant, since a constant c admits F(x,z) = cz. Any source-style flux f(q) representing this spatial operator would provide F(x,z) = f(z) satisfying the denied derivative identity. Thus the translation supplies a variable-coefficient hyperbolic equation lacking the source's conservation form. The obstruction is visible on constant and affine smooth profiles, so it does not confuse failure of classical regularity with absence of integral conservation.
